notes.title: Happy Lab now available on Steam!!!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce you that Happy Lab game is now available for purchase on Steam! 

Welcome to the "Happy Lab"! You are a new intern at the most advanced science facility. Your daily job would be to train our AI "Aurora". "Aurora" purpose is to create the most advanced armor and fix all glitches on the way if there are any.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/649960/Happy_Lab/

Happy Lab is a single-player game where the player takes on the role of an intern who finds themselves in the mysterious Happy Lab, where robot experiments are conducted. On each level, the player unlocks new tools and gameplay mechanics.

Grab it right now!
